versions.changelog:
Initial release of dtek-ligh (dtek-light-check) skill.

- Checks power availability for Odessa, vul. Chikalenka Yevhena, 43 via dtek-oem.com.ua.
- Responds to user queries about local electricity status.
- Requires Playwright with Chromium for operation.
- Returns status and suggests responses based on current power situation.
- Provides troubleshooting instructions for error cases.
